packageRules.description: The dev agent's and the agent builder's images follow the agentctl images as published, so they name the tags alone.
rusqlite picks the SQLite linked into agentd, which follows the Microsandbox fork's lockfile, as the comment on it in Cargo.toml says. Move it by hand when the fork moves.

customManagers.description: The browser feature's playwright-cli version also decides the Chromium build the base images ship.
